doc.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 - art plan
doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 - art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For the Halloween review, Thu Oct 2. Comments welcome.
Tracker (one row per surface and per ad, with call, maker, due date and status): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hhsNIRs4oTen_AVqgDjRveIqyCI41QVCNUS_FwkQ94w/edit

1. Goal
Leonard's ask (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30): everything players see from us looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October, meaning the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live as of Oct 1: 4 store surfaces and 58 Unity ads. That's the 56 on the live creatives sheet plus 2 running ads that aren't on it (ART-826 Julia 4:5 static, ART-831 Marcus portrait UA end card).

2. Inputs used
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick): Store and Unity tabs; campaigns, capture build and master notes from each ART ticket's comments.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12 draft) and the Sep 30 changes, which override the draft: Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12 (budget moves to iOS UK), so no Halloween versions of anything that only runs there. The Halloween flight is Sat Oct 18 to Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (not Oct 17) so Unity can approve it before the flight.
- Frederick's Sep 29 note: squirrelfail landscape and mrfluffernot landscape came off iOS UK tablet and now run only on Android US tablet.
- Frederick's Trello comment on the Halloween push card: Julia's 4:5 static (They're coming, stop them!) is still running on iOS UK and is our best CPI there, so it's in.
- Arthur's ZM3D release calendar, Q4: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. iOS screenshots (and the icon, which ships in the binary) only change with a new version. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so plan on iOS being live from Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics aren't tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review. The Nov 6 submission puts the icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction Q4 2025 deck, plus his Sep 17 note on the icon.
- What's already made: Martin's Halloween store screens (iPhone 6.5" and Google Play phone sets, exported Sep 30 to ZM3D Halloween 2025 > Store), and Marcus's cheer fastcouch Halloween test, 9:16 + 16:9 from the no-music masters (ZM3D Halloween 2025 > UA masters).

3. How each call was made (Robert's rules)
- Halloween version: the current art is clean, so dress it. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment). Same flat background, pose, zombie order and CTA, so it still tests clean against the normal version.
- Refresh first: captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background), or the master has music baked in. Re-capture, re-render or re-cut on the current build first, then do the Halloween pass. If a later capture has already replaced it, the newest capture counts.
- Reuse: it already has a seasonal version, so we use that one.
- Skip: no seasonal version this time. Here that means it only serves on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12.
Who makes what: Martin does the icon and the stills; Marcus does video and end cards.

4. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. Martin, ART-855. Robert's direction is to keep it as simple as the current icon; the Sep 17 concept was too busy at icon size, so it needs a new pass. Art due Mon Oct 13 so it's merged before the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut. iOS goes live with the build around Wed Oct 22. Upload to Google Play Tue Oct 21 so both stores swap Oct 22. On Leonard's "swap the icon around the 24th": the iOS icon can't be timed separately from the build, so I'm proposing Oct 22 on both stores. If we'd rather hold Google Play to the 24th, upload it Oct 23.
- iPhone 6.5" set: REUSE. Martin's export is done. Arthur attaches it to the Oct 17 submission by the Oct 16 cut; live ~Oct 22.
- iPad 12.9" set: HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. Martin, ART-856. This is the only store set not exported yet. Due Tue Oct 14, hard cut Oct 16 12:00 PT; live ~Oct 22.
- Google Play phone set: REUSE. Martin's export is done. Upload Fri Oct 17 so it's live Sat Oct 18 with the flight.
- All of it goes back to normal with the Nov 6 submission. Google Play graphics can be reverted Nov 1.
Martin's exported store sets use the same comps as the live sets, which went live Sep 17 from the post-swap (Aug 28) concept, so they pass Robert's build rule.

5. Ads: summary (58 running today)
- Halloween version: 11. All Marcus (videos and end cards built on post-swap captures with SFX-only masters).
- Refresh first, then Halloween: 35. Marcus has 29 (videos and end cards); Martin has 6 (Julia statics, all from Jun 5 #852 captures).
- Reuse: 2 (cheer fastcouch 9:16 ART-808 and 16:9 ART-816; Marcus's Halloween cuts are already in UA masters, built on the Sep 16 #1896 re-capture).
- Skip: 10 (Android US tablet only: ART-806, 811, 813, 820, 821, 822, 824, 842, 844, 849).
That's 48 Halloween ads for Frederick by Wed Oct 15: 46 to make plus 2 ready. The per-ad detail is in the tracker's Ads tab and on each ART ticket.

Halloween version (to Frederick by Wed Oct 15), Marcus: ART-817/818/819 (marcus.bennett 16:9, 4:5, 1:1); ART-833/834/835/848 (end card 001 family); ART-851 (cheer fastcouch 4:5, match the 9:16/16:9 pass); ART-852 (barrel marketing2 1:1); ART-853 (couch alpha 50 4:5); ART-854 (balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9).

Refresh first (refresh by Fri Oct 10, Halloween version to Frederick by Wed Oct 15):
- Marcus, videos and end cards: ART-793 to ART-805, ART-807, ART-809, 810, 812, 814, 815, 823, 831, 832, 840, 841, 843, 845, 846, 847, 850.
- Martin, stills: ART-825, 826, 827, 828, 829, 830 (Julia statics).
Shortcuts where a newer capture of the same edit already exists: ART-795 and ART-823 from the #1935 couch alpha 50 capture (ART-853); ART-797 from the #1966 balloons capture (ART-854); ART-805 from the #1896 barrel marketing2 capture (ART-852); ART-840 boris fastcouch rebuilt on the #1896 fastcouch re-capture (ART-808) with the Boris opening kept. ART-809 marcus.bennett 9:16 is on a post-swap build, but the 30s cut has music baked in (Aug 13 thread), so it gets re-cut from Marcus's no-music export (InvestorFacing_Seq3_NoMusic). Music-baked masters also need re-cuts on ART-796, 798, 799, 802, 807 and 847.

6. Who makes what by when
- Martin: ART-855 icon by Mon Oct 13; ART-856 iPad set by Tue Oct 14; Julia statics (6) refreshed by Fri Oct 10 and Halloween to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Marcus: 29 refresh-first ads refreshed by Fri Oct 10; those plus 11 Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (40 total).
- Robert: sign-off on the icon (by Oct 13) and spot checks on the first Halloween ad batch.
- Arthur: icon and iOS screenshots into the Oct 17 build by the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut; Halloween revert in the Nov 6 submission.
- Frederick: upload and approve the Halloween ads in Unity by Oct 17 for the Oct 18 flight; upload the GP screenshots Oct 17 and the GP icon Oct 21; drop the Android US tablet ads Oct 12.
- Claire: review each batch as it lands, keep the tracker current, handle reverts.

7. Risks / decisions for Thursday
- Marcus's load: 40 ads (29 of them refresh-first) by Oct 15 is the critical path. Options: batch the refresh captures by edit family (couch, balloons, barrel, cheer, boris, tutorial, end cards) so one capture session covers several formats; pull in extra help; or, if we have to cut, drop the lowest-spend refresh-first ads to Skip. I'd like Frederick's spend ranking to decide that.
- Icon date: Oct 22 on both stores versus Leonard's Oct 24 idea (iOS is locked to the build).
- iOS store and icon aren't live until ~Oct 22, four days after the ads and Google Play go Halloween on Oct 18.
- The live creatives sheet is missing ART-826 and ART-831. Frederick, please add them so the sheet matches what's serving.

new_tickets.title: ZM3D Halloween app icon (App Store + Google Play)
new_tickets.description:
Halloween version of the live app icon (live since Sep 17 on App Store + Google Play) for the ZM3D Halloween push.

**Direction (Robert):** keep it as simple as the current icon - only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkin / fog / prop / title treatment), same character, pose and flat background. The Sep 17 concept in #zombie-art was too busy at icon size, so this is a new pass rather than a reuse. Robert signs off.

**Timing (Arthur's Q4 release calendar):**
- The icon ships in the binary, so it has to be in the Oct 17 build: merge cut **Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT**. Art due **Mon Oct 13** so Robert can review and eng can merge before the cut.
- Apple review takes up to 3 days, so the iOS icon goes live with that build from about **Wed Oct 22**. Leonard suggested the 24th; on iOS it can't be timed separately from the build, so the plan is Oct 22 on both stores.
- Google Play listing icon: upload Tue Oct 21 (1 day review) to go live with iOS on Oct 22.
- Back to the normal icon in the Nov 6 submission (post-Halloween clean-up).

Deliver to: ZM3D Halloween 2025 > Store. Tracker and plan are linked in Leonard's #zombie_marketing thread.

doc.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — Art Plan
doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — Art Plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For review Thu Oct 2. Please comment directly in this doc.
Tracker (one row per item, owners and due dates): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1V_wQcgWWVjGjPNtb37a_Q0_YckI9wB1120nPtDehl44/edit

1. Goal
Everything players see from Zombie Match 3D looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the store pages on both stores and every ad running on Unity. This plan goes through everything live today (Oct 1) and gives each item one call, an owner and a due date.

2. Sources used
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick) plus the ART ticket comments for capture build, master and campaigns.
- Frederick's Trello comment on the Halloween push card: Julia's 4:5 static (ART-826, "They're coming, stop them!") is still running on iOS UK and is our best CPI there, but is not on the sheet. Counted in.
- ART-831 (Marcus's portrait UA end card, plays after every Android US phone video) is still running per Frederick's Sep 29 ticket comment, also not on the sheet. Counted in.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12) and his changes email (Sep 30). The Sep 30 email wins where they differ.
- Arthur's ZM3D release calendar — Q4.
- Robert's deck "Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025", and his Sep 17 note on the icon.
- Martin's Halloween store exports (Sep 30) and Marcus's Halloween test on cheer fastcouch (Sep 29), both in the ZM3D Halloween 2025 Drive folder.

3. Key dates
- Unity campaigns in the Halloween flight: iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet, Android US phone. Flight runs Sat Oct 18 – Fri Oct 31.
- Android US tablet campaign ends Sun Oct 12 (budget moves to iOS UK), so anything that only runs there gets no Halloween version.
- Every Halloween ad must be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (Unity needs upload + approval before the flight starts). This replaces the Oct 17 date in the Sep 12 draft.
- Proposed internal checkpoint: refreshed (re-captured / re-cut) versions done by Fri Oct 10, so the seasonal pass fits before Oct 15.
- Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. New iOS screenshots and the app icon must be in by that cut.
- Apple review up to 3 days: plan on the Halloween build and iOS listing being live from Wed Oct 22.
- Google Play listing graphics are not tied to a build: upload any day, allow 1 day for review.
- Nov 6 submission: icon and screenshots back to normal.

4. Rules applied (Robert's seasonal art direction)
- Seasonal dressing only goes on top of current art. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture counts.
- A video whose master has music baked in is re-cut first from a master without music (re-export one if none exists).
- Only the seasonal layer changes: pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment. Same flat background, same pose, same zombie order, same CTA, so each Halloween variant still tests clean against its normal version.
- Calls: Halloween version (dress it from current art) / Refresh first (re-capture, re-render or re-cut, then the seasonal pass) / Reuse (a seasonal version already exists) / Skip (no seasonal version this time).
- Icon (Robert, Sep 17): a Halloween icon must stay as simple as the current one; Martin's Sep 17 draft is nice for an event but too busy at icon size.

5. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. Martin. Final art merged by Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT so it ships in the Oct 17 build. New ART ticket: ART-855 (https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855).
  On "swap the icon around the 24th": the icon lives in the build, so it can't be swapped on its own date. With the Oct 17 submission it goes live on iOS around Wed Oct 22 (two days before the 24th) and comes out in the Nov 6 build. If we wanted a later swap there is no later Halloween build to carry it. Arthur to confirm Android rollout timing.
- iPhone 6.5" set (App Store): REUSE. Martin's Halloween set is exported (5 shots, Store folder). Attach to the Oct 17 submission by the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut; live from ~Oct 22. Revert with Nov 6.

doc.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For the Thu Oct 2 Halloween review. Comment anywhere.
Tracker (every line item, maker, due date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JID5a5N-BvA2J0invQvfz5UPoMxqzSTJsrzIAf-jk2k/edit

1. Goal
Everything players see from us looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the App Store and Google Play pages and every Unity ad we're running (Leonard, #zombie_marketing, Sep 30).

2. Inputs
- Live creatives sheet (Frederick): 4 store surfaces and 56 Unity creatives. Two more live ads aren't on the sheet and are included here: ART-826 julia 4:5 static ("They're coming, stop them!"), our best iOS UK CPI per Frederick's Trello note, and ART-831 Marcus's portrait UA end card, which plays after every Android US phone video. Total: 58 ads.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12 draft + Sep 30 changes, which replace the draft): Halloween flight is Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12, so nothing that only runs there gets a Halloween version. Every Halloween ad must be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (not Oct 17), so Unity can approve it before the flight. Per his Sep 29 note, squirrelfail landscape and mrfluffernot landscape were taken off iOS UK tablet and now run only on Android US tablet.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT, submit Fri Oct 17, the last build that can carry Halloween. iOS icon and screenshots only change with a build, so they are due at the cut and go live ~Wed Oct 22 (Apple review up to 3 days). Google Play listing graphics can go up any day with 1-day review. Nov 6 submission puts icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's seasonal art direction (Q4 deck): the seasonal layer goes on top of current art only. Anything captured or rendered before Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (Jul 29 zombie swap + new background) is redone on the current build first; if a newer capture replaced it, the newest one counts. A video with music baked into its master is re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); same background, pose, zombie order and CTA, so each variant tests clean against its normal version.
- Already made: Martin's Halloween iPhone 6.5" set (5 screens) and Google Play phone set (6 screens), exported Sep 30 to ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store. Marcus's Halloween cheer fastcouch 9:16 and 16:9, made from the no-music #1896 masters, in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / UA masters. Leonard confirmed exported store art needs no tickets.

3. The calls (Robert's vocabulary)
- Halloween version: current build, no baked music. Dress it directly.
- Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut on the current build, then dress it.
- Reuse: a Halloween version already exists. Use it.
- Skip: no Halloween version this time.

4. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): NEW ART, Martin, ART-855. No approved Halloween icon exists; Robert said Martin's Sep 17 concept was too busy at icon size and it must stay as simple as the current one. Concept to Robert Fri Oct 10, final assets to engineering Tue Oct 14, merged by the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut. iOS goes live ~Oct 22 with the build. Google Play: upload Tue Oct 21 so both stores switch around Oct 22.
  On "swap the icon around the 24th": on iOS the icon is in the build, so it switches when the Oct 17 build clears review (~Oct 22); we can't choose the 24th, and there's no other build before Nov 6. Google Play could switch on the 24th (upload Oct 23), but I'd recommend matching iOS on ~Oct 22. Decision for Thursday.
- iPhone 6.5" set: REUSE Martin's export. Goes up with the Oct 17 submission, live ~Oct 22.
- iPad 12.9" set: NEW ART, Martin, ART-856. The only store set with no Halloween version. Same comps as the live iPad set + seasonal layer, matching the iPhone set. Target Tue Oct 14; hard deadline Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT.
- Google Play phone set: REUSE Martin's export. Upload Fri Oct 17 so it's live ~Sat Oct 18 with the ad flight.
- Nov 6: Arthur reverts icon and screenshots.

5. Ads (58 live today) - summary
- Refresh first: 35 (Marcus 29 videos/end cards, Martin 6 statics)
- Halloween version: 11 (Marcus)
- Reuse: 2 (ART-808 cheer fastcouch 9:16, ART-816 cheer fastcouch 16:9)
- Skip: 10 (only on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12: ART-806, 811, 813, 820, 821, 822, 824, 842, 844, 849)
Line-by-line calls, sources and reasons are in the tracker's Ads tab and on each ART ticket.

Things worth knowing:
- Nearly all video was captured in April-July or from the prototype (Dec 2024), before #1452, so most of the work is Refresh first. Many refreshes share one capture across aspect ratios (couch boss 30 9:16/16:9; cinematicTutorial 9:16/16:9; tutorialCinematic 9:16/1:1; cheer 30p 9:16/4:5; boris alin2 9:16/16:9), so the real number of re-captures is lower than 29.
- Some edits already have current-build captures in another ratio: couch alpha 50 (#1935, ART-853), balloons alpha 50 (1) (#1966, ART-854), barrel marketing2 (#1896, ART-852). Marcus can start the 9:16/16:9/4:5 refreshes of those from that footage.
- Music baked in: ART-796, 798, 799, 802, 807, 847, plus ART-809 (marcus.bennett 9:16; Marcus already exported a no-music master on Aug 13, so it's a re-cut, not a re-capture).
- ART-831 (portrait UA end card) was rendered from #1450, two builds before the swap, so it needs a refresh. It's not on the live sheet but plays after every Android US phone video.
- ART-826 (julia 4:5) is our best iOS UK performer: Martin does it first.
- cheer fastcouch 4:5 (ART-851) gets its own Halloween version. Marcus's existing Halloween cuts are 9:16 and 16:9 only.

6. Who makes what, by when
- Marcus (video + end cards): 29 Refresh first + 11 Halloween version = 40 deliverables. Refreshed masters by Wed Oct 8; all Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Martin (icon + stills): 6 julia statics (Refresh first): refreshed by Wed Oct 8, Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. Icon (ART-855) and iPad set (ART-856) as above.
- Frederick: upload and get Unity approval for everything from Oct 15 for the Oct 18 flight. The two Reuse cuts are ready now.
- Arthur: Oct 17 submission carries icon + iOS screenshots; Google Play set up Oct 17, Google Play icon Oct 21; revert Nov 6.
- Robert: sign off icon concept Oct 10; spot-check first refreshed + dressed ads around Oct 8-10.
- Claire: owns the plan, reviews Halloween passes against Robert's direction, keeps the tracker current.

7. Risks / decisions for Thursday
- Marcus's load: 40 deliverables in two weeks is a lot. Options: Julia (who made the statics) or Martin take some end-card passes; or prioritize by spend and accept that low-spend creatives keep running unthemed. Need Frederick's spend ranking to decide.
- Icon timing: confirm ~Oct 22 on both stores rather than the 24th (see section 4).
- iOS store goes Halloween ~Oct 22, four days after the ads (Oct 18). That's a build-review constraint; Google Play matches the ads on Oct 18.
- Who uploads Google Play listing graphics: I've put Arthur; please confirm.

8. Ticket hygiene
Every ad's ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date. Tickets needing new work (Halloween version or Refresh first) are assigned to Marcus or Martin with a due date of Oct 15 and moved back to Todo, so Frederick can see what's coming. Reuse and Skip tickets are commented only.

new_tickets.title: ZM3D Halloween app icon (App Store + Google Play)
new_tickets.description:
New store art for the ZM3D Halloween push (Leonard's ask in #zombie_marketing, Sep 30).

**What:** a Halloween variant of the current app icon for both App Store and Google Play.
**Direction (Robert):** keep it as simple as the current icon. The Sep 17 Halloween concept in #zombie-art was too busy at icon size. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkin/fog/prop/title treatment) on top of the current art; same background, pose and composition.

**Dates (Arthur's Q4 release calendar):**
- Concept for Robert's sign-off: Fri Oct 10
- Final iOS + Android icon assets to engineering: Tue Oct 14
- Must be merged by the Oct 16 12:00 PT merge cut; ships in the Oct 17 submission, iOS live ~Wed Oct 22 after review
- Google Play icon: upload Tue Oct 21 (1-day review) so both stores switch ~Oct 22
- Back to the normal icon in the Nov 6 submission

Note on "swap around the 24th": on iOS the icon ships in the build, so it goes live when the Oct 17 build clears review (~Oct 22). There's no later build before Nov 6.

doc.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art Lead). For the Halloween review, Thu Oct 2, 9:00 PT. Please comment inline.
Tracker (every item, call, owner and date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rpB8BgFxuYa8e2c6WQ6KHUs9WLr6BKjyQCZsIN5_BuY/edit

Goal
Leonard asked (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30) for everything players see from Zombie Match 3D to look like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live on Oct 1. For each item it gives the Halloween call, what has to happen first, what we already have, and who makes what by when.

What this is built on
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick): 4 store surfaces and 56 Unity rows, plus each ad's ART ticket notes (capture build, master, campaigns).
- Two live ads that aren't on the sheet: julia 4:5 "They're coming, stop them!" (ART-826), still on iOS UK and our best CPI there (Frederick on the Trello card, Sep 30), and Marcus's portrait UA end card (ART-831), which plays after every Android US phone video (ticket note, Sep 29). That makes 58 live ads.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12), plus his Sep 29 restart note and Sep 30 changes. The Sep 30 changes override the draft: the Halloween flight is now Sat Oct 18 to Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12. Every Halloween ad is due to Frederick by Wed Oct 15, not the 17th.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween (merge cut Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT). iOS screenshots only change with a new version. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so the build is live ~Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics can go up any day with a 1-day review. The Nov 6 submission puts things back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025: dress only current art. Anything from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) is redone first, and a newer capture of the same thing counts. Masters with music baked in get re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same so variants test clean.

How the calls work (Robert's four)
- Halloween version: dress it from the current art.
- Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut before any seasonal pass.
- Reuse: it already has a seasonal version, so use that one.
- Skip: no seasonal version this time. Here that means anything that only runs on Android US tablet, since that campaign ends Oct 12, before the flight.

Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): Halloween version, new. Owner Martin, ART-856. No Halloween icon exists. Robert ruled the Sep 17 concept too busy for an icon, so it stays as simple as the current one with just a seasonal accent. The icon ships in the build, so the art is due at the Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT merge cut and goes live with the Oct 17 build, ~Wed Oct 22. Leonard, on "swap around the 24th": that would need a separate build after the last Halloween one, so ~Oct 22 is the realistic swap. Upload the Google Play listing icon the same day so the stores match. It reverts with the Nov 6 submission.
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse. Martin exported 5 Halloween screens on Sep 30 (same comps, seasonal layer). Done, so no ticket. Arthur: this set must go in the Oct 17 submission. Live ~Oct 22, reverts Nov 6.
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version, new. Owner Martin, ART-855. It's the one store set not in the Halloween folder. Due Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT, rides the Oct 17 submission, live ~Oct 22.
- Google Play phone set: Reuse. Martin exported 6 Halloween screens on Sep 30. Done, so no ticket. It isn't tied to a build, so I propose uploading Fri Oct 17 to go live with the ad flight on Sat Oct 18 (owner to confirm at the review). Swap back Nov 1 or with the Nov 6 submission.

Ads (58 live today)
- 13 Halloween version, all Marcus: the ads already on current captures with SFX-only masters. That's cheer fastcouch 9:16 / 16:9 / 4:5 (ART-808/816/851), marcus.bennett 16:9 / 4:5 / 1:1 (ART-817/818/819), barrel marketing2 1:1 (ART-852), couch alpha 50 4:5 (ART-853), balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9 (ART-854), and end card 001 in 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 / 4:5 (ART-833/834/835/848). All due to Frederick Wed Oct 15.
- 35 Refresh first: 29 for Marcus (videos and end cards), 6 for Martin (the julia statics). Almost all were captured on April-July builds or the Dec 2024 prototype, before the zombie swap. Seven also have music baked in (balloons alpha 50, barrel alpha 30, couch marketing2 30s, couch alpha 30 endcard, cheer 30p 9:16 and 4:5, marcus.bennett 9:16). marcus.bennett 9:16 is on a current capture and only needs a re-cut from Marcus's Aug 13 no-music export. The portrait UA end card (ART-831) is from #1450, two builds before the swap. Refreshes are due Wed Oct 8 so Robert can check them, then the Halloween pass goes to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- 0 Reuse. Marcus's Sep 29 cheer fastcouch Halloween test (9:16 + 16:9 in UA masters) can't ship: it was cut on the July capture with the old background (Robert, Sep 30). Marcus is redoing both from the Sep 16 #1896 capture, so those count as Halloween versions.
- 10 Skip: barrel marketing2 16:9, cheer 30p 16:9, couch alpha 30 16:9, balloons alpha 50 16:9, barrel alpha 30 endcard 16:9, boris fastcouch 16:9, couch marketing2 30s 16:9, julia 1:1 android tablet, and squirrelfail landscape / mrfluffernot landscape. Frederick pulled those last two off iOS UK tablet on Sep 29, so they now only run on Android US tablet.

Shortcuts for the refreshes
- couch alpha 50 (ART-795) and its 16:9 (ART-823): use the Sep 23 #1935 capture of the same edit (ART-853).
- balloons alpha 50 (1) (ART-797): use the Sep 25 #1966 capture (ART-854).
- barrel marketing2 4:5 (ART-805): use the Sep 17 #1896 export (ART-852).
- boris fastcouch 9:16 (ART-840): keep the Sep 11 Boris opening and rebuild the gameplay on the Sep 16 #1896 fastcouch re-capture.
- marcus.bennett 9:16 (ART-809): re-cut from the Aug 13 no-music export (InvestorFacing_Seq3_NoMusic).

Who makes what by when
- Martin Walsh (icon and stills): Halloween icon (ART-856) and iPad 12.9" set (ART-855) by Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. Julia statics ART-825/826/827/828/829/830: refreshed by Wed Oct 8, Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. ART-826 comes first, since it's our best iOS UK CPI.
- Marcus Bennett (video and end cards): 13 Halloween versions and 29 refresh-first videos/end cards. Refreshes by Wed Oct 8, everything to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. Start with the iOS UK phone and Android US phone 9:16s, since they cover two of the three flight campaigns.
- Frederick Stone: uploads to Unity and gets approval between Oct 15 and the flight start on Oct 18. Each ad's ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date, and the new-work tickets are assigned to the maker, so the upload queue can be read straight off Linear.
- Arthur Blake: put the Halloween icon plus the iPhone 6.5" and iPad 12.9" sets in the Oct 17 submission, and the normal ones back in the Nov 6 submission.
- Robert: sign off the refreshes by Oct 8 and the Halloween passes before Oct 15.
- Claire Morgan: owns the plan and tracker, reviews art against Robert's direction, and chases dates.

Risks and decisions for Thursday
1. Marcus's load. 42 video/end card deliverables in two weeks, 29 of them needing a re-capture or re-cut first, is the biggest risk to Oct 15. Options: (a) get help with the re-captures (Julia has done gameplay captures for UA before; Frederick cut most of the original edits), (b) cut low performers from the flight instead of dressing them; Frederick, which ones would you drop? (c) prioritise phone 9:16s and let lower-spend tablet variants run un-themed. I need a decision at the review.
2. Icon date. ~Oct 22 with the build, not Oct 24 (see Store pages). Leonard to confirm that's fine.
3. Google Play listing timing and owner: proposed Fri Oct 17 upload for an Oct 18 go-live, with the swap back on Nov 1.
4. Live creatives sheet gaps: ART-826 and ART-831 are live but missing from Frederick's sheet. Worth adding them so the Halloween uploads track cleanly.
5. Wind-down: the flight ends Fri Oct 31. Frederick to swap the normal ads back in on Nov 1. The store reverts with the Nov 6 submission.

run-4.final_response:
The Halloween plan and tracker are in your Drive and shared as commenter with everyone on Thursday's review (Leonard, Frederick, Martin, Marcus, Robert, Arthur). All 58 ad tickets have their call and due date, and both links are posted in Leonard's thread.

- **Plan doc:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/ed560819ef06efd26407ce4c/edit
- **Tracker:** https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rpB8BgFxuYa8e2c6WQ6KHUs9WLr6BKjyQCZsIN5_BuY/edit (tabs for summary, ads, store and key dates)
- **Thread reply:** https://harmonygamesgroup.slack.com/archives/C06DJBJL798/p1759302895000000

**Store pages**
- **Reuse:** Martin already exported Halloween versions of the iPhone 6.5" set and the Google Play phone set on Sep 30. Per Leonard, finished art doesn't get a ticket.
- **New:** the Halloween icon is ART-856 and the iPad 12.9" set is ART-855. Both are assigned to Martin, due Thu Oct 16 at 12:00 PT so they make the Oct 17 build.
- **Icon timing:** Leonard's "around the 24th" doesn't work. The icon ships inside the app, and per Arthur's calendar the Oct 17 build is the last one that can carry Halloween. So it goes live when that build clears review, around Oct 22.

**Ads (58 live)**
- **Two ads missing from the sheet:** julia 4:5 (ART-826, Frederick flagged it on Trello as the best iOS UK performer) and Marcus's portrait end card (ART-831). Both are counted.
- **Dates:** Frederick's Sep 30 changes override his draft plan. The flight is now Oct 18–31, Android US tablet ends Oct 12, and every Halloween ad is due to him Wed Oct 15.
- **13 straight Halloween versions**, all Marcus.
- **35 need a refresh before the Halloween pass:** 29 for Marcus, 6 for Martin. They were captured before Robert's Jul 29 cutoff and/or have music baked in. I set an internal Oct 8 checkpoint for these so Robert can check them.
- **10 skipped:** they only run on Android US tablet, which ends before the flight.
- **No reuse:** Marcus's cheer fastcouch Halloween test sits on the old July capture, which Robert ruled out. Marcus has already said he'll redo it from the Sep 16 capture.
- **Assignments:** each of the 58 tickets has a comment with its call and due date. The 48 that need work are assigned to Marcus or Martin with an Oct 15 due date. I left their status as Done.

**Decisions for Thursday**
- **Marcus's workload is the biggest risk:** 42 video and end-card deliverables by Oct 15. The plan offers three options: get help with the re-captures, drop low performers from the flight, or theme only the phone 9:16s.
- **Assumptions to confirm:**
  - I proposed uploading the Google Play listing on Oct 17; it still needs an owner.
  - The julia statics went to Martin because Leonard said Martin has the stills.
  - The Oct 8 refresh checkpoint is my own date, not one anyone asked for.

doc.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For review Thu Oct 2. Comment anywhere.
Tracker (every live surface, one row each): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iPVHXtpzN_RxXpTtXEHM6Bll_LgCLdPu4-GgFVlZ5lI/edit

1. Goal
Leonard's ask (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30): everything players see from us should look like Halloween for the last stretch of October, meaning the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live today (Oct 1): the 4 store surfaces, plus 58 Unity creatives (56 on the live creatives sheet, plus 2 that are live but missing from it).

2. Dates that drive everything
- Sun Oct 12: the Android US tablet campaign ends, so anything that only runs there gets no Halloween version (Frederick, Sep 30).
- Wed Oct 15: every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick. Unity needs creatives uploaded and approved before the flight starts. (This replaces the Oct 17 date in his Sep 12 draft.)
- Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT: merge cut for the Oct 17 submission, the last build that can carry Halloween changes. The icon and new iOS screenshots have to be in by then (Arthur's Q4 release calendar).
- Sat Oct 18 to Fri Oct 31: the Halloween flight on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone.
- About Wed Oct 22: the Oct 17 build and iOS store listing go live (Apple review is taking up to 3 days).

run-5.final_response:
I've done everything from Leonard's message. The plan doc and tracker are in your Drive, shared as commenter with Leonard, Frederick, Martin, Marcus, Robert and Arthur, and I've replied in his thread with both links.

- **Plan:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/3689969d8464f26864b5769b/edit
- **Tracker:** https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iPVHXtpzN_RxXpTtXEHM6Bll_LgCLdPu4-GgFVlZ5lI/edit (one row per live ad and store surface, plus a summary and the key dates)
- **Slack reply:** https://harmonygamesgroup.slack.com/archives/C06DJBJL798/p1759302555000000?thread_ts=1759269913.882683&cid=C06DJBJL798

**Dates that drive everything**
- **Flight:** Frederick's Sep 30 email moved the Halloween flight to Sat Oct 18–Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone.
- **Android US tablet:** this campaign ends Oct 12, so anything that only runs there is skipped.
- **Ad deadline:** every Halloween ad is due to Frederick by **Wed Oct 15**.
- **Store deadline:** the new icon and iOS screenshots have to be merged by **Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT** to make the Oct 17 submission.

**Ads: 58 live**
That's 56 from the live creatives sheet plus two that are running but missing from it: Julia's 4:5 static (ART-826, still our best CPI on iOS UK) and Marcus's portrait end card (ART-831).
- **Halloween version, 13 (all Marcus):** these are already on the current build with no-music masters.
- **Refresh first, 35 (Marcus 29, Martin 6):** these were captured before the Jul 29 zombie swap, or have music baked into the master, so Robert's direction says they get redone before the Halloween layer.
- **Skip, 10:** all only run on Android US tablet.
- **Reuse, 0:** Marcus's Sep 29 cheer fastcouch test can't be used. Robert flagged that it sits on the July capture with the old background.

All 58 ART tickets have a comment with the call and due date. The 48 that need work are assigned with a due date of Oct 15. I left their status as Done; move them back to To Do if you want them to show up as active work.

**Store**
- **iPhone 6.5" and Google Play sets:** reuse. Martin already exported both on Sep 30, and Leonard said exported work needs no ticket.
- **New tickets, both Martin, both due at the Oct 16 cut:**
  - ART-855, Halloween icon. Robert's note: keep it as simple as the current icon.
  - ART-856, iPad 12.9" set.
- **Icon on the 24th:** we can't swap it on a date of our choosing because it ships inside the build. It goes out with the Oct 17 submission, should be live on iOS around Oct 22, and reverts with the Nov 6 submission. I've put this in the plan and the Slack reply.

**To decide Thursday**
- **Marcus's load:** 42 deliverables by Oct 15, and 29 of them need a re-capture or re-cut first. The plan offers options: Frederick re-cuts the ads he originally made, or we trim the refresh list to the best performers.
- **Google Play upload:** I proposed uploading the Halloween set by Fri Oct 17, but we need to agree who does it.
- **Refresh checkpoint:** I suggested having the refreshed cuts done by about Oct 10, which leaves time for the Halloween pass and Robert's review. That's my suggestion, not a date anyone has committed to.

doc.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 - Art plan
doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 - Art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art Lead). For the Halloween review, Thu Oct 2, 9:00 PT. Please comment inline.
Tracker (one row per surface, with who/when/status): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1p3XlRyWQ4C-NPBrZKSEOMNpmHUJrSLMbaqnsRfr_x-k/edit

1. Goal
Leonard asked for everything players see from Zombie Match 3D to look like Halloween for the last stretch of October: both store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers what's live today (the live creatives sheet, plus two live ads that aren't on it), the call for each one, who makes it and by when.

2. Inputs
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick): 56 Unity rows + 4 store surfaces
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12) and his changes (Sep 30): the Halloween flight is now Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12, so nothing that only runs there gets a Halloween version. Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15
- Frederick, Sep 29: squirrelfail landscape and mrfluffernot landscape are off iOS UK tablet and stay on Android US tablet only
- Frederick on the Trello Halloween card: julia 4:5 static (They're coming, stop them!, ART-826) is still live on iOS UK and is our best CPI there, but isn't on the sheet. Count it in
- ART-831 (Marcus's portrait UA end card) is live on Android US phone and plays after every Android US phone video, but isn't on the sheet either. Counted in
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. iOS screenshots only change with a new version. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so iOS goes live Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics can go up any day with 1-day review. The Nov 6 submission puts things back to normal
- Robert's seasonal art direction (Q4 2025): dress on top of current art only. Anything captured or rendered before Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap + new background) gets redone on the current build first; if a newer capture has replaced it, the newest one counts. Videos with music baked into the master are re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same so each variant tests clean against its normal version
- Capture/master notes and campaigns on every ad's ART ticket
- Existing Halloween work in Drive (ZM3D Halloween 2025): Martin's Halloween store screens (iPhone 6.5" x5, Google Play phone x6, Sep 30) and Marcus's Halloween cheer fastcouch 9:16 + 16:9 (Sep 29, from the no-music masters)

3. Calls (Robert's vocabulary)
- Halloween version: dress it from the current art
- Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut on the current build (no music) before the seasonal pass
- Reuse: a Halloween version already exists, use it
- Skip: no Halloween version this time

4. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): Halloween version. Martin, ART-855 (new). Keep it as simple as today's icon (Robert). Art to engineering by Tue Oct 14 so it can be merged by the Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT cut, then it ships in the Oct 17 build and goes live Wed Oct 22. On swapping around the 24th: that can't happen. The icon is part of the build, and Oct 17 is the last build that can carry Halloween changes, so the earliest and only Halloween icon date is Oct 22. It goes back to normal with the Nov 6 submission
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse Martin's exported Halloween set. No ticket needed (already exported, per Leonard). Uploaded with the Oct 17 submission, live Oct 22, back with Nov 6
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version. Martin, ART-856 (new). There's no Halloween iPad set yet. Due Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT with the Oct 17 submission, live Oct 22, back with Nov 6
- Google Play phone set: Reuse Martin's exported Halloween set. Upload Fri Oct 17, so after the 1-day review it's live Sat Oct 18, lining up with the ad flight. Upload the normal set Sat Nov 1

5. Ads (58 live: the 56 on the sheet plus ART-826 and ART-831)
Summary: 11 Halloween version, 35 Refresh first, 2 Reuse, 10 Skip.
Every Halloween ad is due to Frederick Wed Oct 15. Refresh work is due Wed Oct 8, so there's a week left for the seasonal pass.
Who makes it, per Leonard: Marcus does video and end cards, Martin does stills.

doc.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For the Thu Oct 2 Halloween review. Please comment directly in this doc.
Tracker (every item, call, owner and due date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit

1. Goal
Leonard wants everything players see from us to look like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live today (Oct 1), the Halloween call for each piece, who makes it, and by when.

2. What's live today
Store: app icon, iPhone 6.5" set and iPad 12.9" set (App Store), and the Google Play phone set. All live since Sep 17.
Ads: 58 Unity creatives across iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet, Android US phone and Android US tablet. That's the 56 on the ZM3D live creatives sheet plus two that are running but missing from the sheet:
- ART-826 julia 4:5 static ("They're coming, stop them!"): still on iOS UK and still our best CPI there (Frederick's comment on the ZM roadmap Halloween card).
- ART-831 Marcus's portrait UA end card: plays after every Android US phone video (Frederick, checked Sep 29).
Frederick, can we add both to the sheet?

3. Inputs and the rules they set
- Frederick's Sep 30 UA changes: Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12 and its budget moves to iOS UK, so no Halloween versions of anything that only runs there. The Halloween flight is Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 so Unity can approve it before the flight. This replaces the Oct 17 date in his Sep 12 draft.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. The merge cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. New iOS screenshots (and the icon, which ships in the build) must be in by then. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so plan on the iOS build and listing being live from about Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics aren't tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review. The Nov 6 submission puts the icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction (Q4 2025): seasonal dressing only goes on top of current art. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture counts. A video whose master has music baked in is re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same so each variant tests clean against its normal version.
- Calls (from Robert's deck): Halloween version = dress it from the current art. Refresh first = re-capture, re-render or re-cut, then the Halloween pass. Reuse = a Halloween version already exists. Skip = no Halloween version this time.
- Who makes what (Leonard): Martin does the icon and stills (store screenshots and Julia's statics). Marcus does video and end cards.
- Store tickets (Leonard, #zombie-art Sep 30): store art that's already exported is done and needs no ticket. Tickets are only for store art that still has to be made.

4. Store pages
- App icon: Halloween version, Martin, new ticket ART-856. The Sep 17 draft was too busy at icon size, and Robert wants it as simple as the current icon. Due Wed Oct 15 to Arthur; the hard cut is the Oct 16 12:00 PT merge.
  On swapping the icon around the 24th: on iOS the icon is part of the build, so the only Halloween window is the Oct 17 submission, live about Oct 22. It can't change on Oct 24 by itself. Proposal: upload the Google Play icon Tue Oct 21 so both stores switch on Oct 22. Both revert with the Nov 6 submission.
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse. Martin's Halloween set (5 screens) is already in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store and goes up with the Oct 17 submission. Live about Oct 22.
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version, Martin, new ticket ART-855. No Halloween iPad set exists yet. Due Wed Oct 15; hard cut Oct 16 12:00 PT.
- Google Play phone set: Reuse. Martin's Halloween set (6 screens) is already exported. Upload Fri Oct 17 so it's live Sat Oct 18 with the flight.

5. Ads (58)
Summary: 14 Halloween versions, 34 refresh first, 2 reuse, 8 skip. Every ad call and due date is also commented on its ART ticket, and every ad that needs new work is assigned to its maker.
Due dates: refresh-first work by Wed Oct 8, so the Halloween pass still has a week. Every Halloween ad to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.

Reuse (2), ready now:
- ART-808 cheer fastcouch 9:16 and ART-816 cheer fastcouch 16:9: Marcus's Halloween cuts from the no-music masters are already in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / UA masters. Frederick can queue them now.

Halloween version (14). All current captures (Android #1529 or later) with no-music masters:
- Marcus: ART-795 couch alpha 50, ART-797 balloons alpha 50 (1), ART-805 barrel marketing2 4:5, ART-817 / 818 / 819 marcus.bennett 16:9, 4:5, 1:1, ART-833 / 834 / 835 / 848 end card 001 (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5), ART-851 cheer fastcouch 4:5, ART-852 barrel marketing2 1:1, ART-853 couch alpha 50 4:5, ART-854 balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9.

Refresh first (34):
- Marcus, pre-#1452 captures: ART-793 couch boss 30, ART-794 couch alpha 30, ART-800 / 801 / 803 / 804 9:16 endcard cuts, ART-810 / 811 squirrelfail, ART-812 / 813 mrfluffernot, ART-814 / 815 / 845 / 846 cinematic tutorials (all prototype captures from Dec 2024), ART-823 couch alpha 50 16:9 (re-export from the Sep 22 #1935 re-capture), ART-831 portrait UA end card (rendered from #1450, two builds before the swap), ART-832 end card template 16:9, ART-840 boris fastcouch 9:16 (gameplay captured Jul 28), ART-841 / 850 boris alin2, ART-843 couch boss 30 16:9.
- Marcus, pre-#1452 AND music baked into the master (re-capture and cut a no-music master): ART-796 balloons alpha 50, ART-798 barrel alpha 30, ART-799 couch marketing2 30s, ART-802 couch alpha 30 endcard, ART-807 cheer 30p 9:16, ART-847 cheer 30p 4:5.
- Marcus, current capture but music baked in: ART-809 marcus.bennett 9:16. Re-cut it from his Aug 13 no-music export (InvestorFacing_Seq3_NoMusic).
- Martin, Julia's statics, all made from Android #852 captures (Jun 5): ART-825 julia 1:1, ART-826 julia 4:5 (best iOS UK CPI, so prioritise it), ART-827 julia 9:16, ART-828 julia 16:9, ART-829 julia 1:1 android 1080, ART-830 julia 4:5 android 1080x1350.

Skip (8). They only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12:
- ART-806 barrel marketing2 16:9, ART-820 cheer 30p 16:9, ART-821 couch alpha 30 16:9, ART-822 balloons alpha 50 16:9, ART-824 barrel alpha 30 endcard 16:9, ART-842 boris fastcouch 16:9, ART-844 couch marketing2 30s 16:9, ART-849 julia 1:1 android tablet.

6. Who makes what, by when
- Marcus Bennett: 28 refresh-first by Wed Oct 8, then 42 Halloween ads (28 refreshed + 14 straight Halloween) to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Martin Walsh: 6 Julia statics refreshed by Wed Oct 8 and Halloween to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. Icon (ART-856) and iPad set (ART-855) by Wed Oct 15.
- Frederick Stone: queue the Halloween uploads as they land (the 2 reuse cuts are ready now). Flight Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31.
- Arthur Blake: icon and iPhone + iPad Halloween screenshots in the Oct 17 submission (merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT). Normal art back in the Nov 6 submission.
- Store uploads: Google Play screenshots on Fri Oct 17, Google Play icon on Tue Oct 21, swapped back for the Nov 6 clean-up. Leonard, who owns these uploads?

7. Risks and open questions
- Marcus's load: 42 ads, 28 of them re-captures first. If that's too much by Oct 15, we can drop the weakest refresh-first ads to Skip rather than put a stale build in a Halloween ad. Frederick, can you rank the refresh-first ads by spend?
- The icon has the least slack: Robert has to sign off on a simpler comp, and engineering has to merge it before noon PT Oct 16.
- The live creatives sheet is missing ART-826 and ART-831. Both are in this plan.
- Halloween props: the Halloween pack we already use (pumpkins, fog) covers the dressing, so we don't need the outside props bundle that was pitched to me.

slack_posts.text:
Halloween art plan and tracker are ready for Thursday's review. Both are shared with everyone on the invite so you can comment:
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/37dbe022571a2be12f93ffe1/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit

The short version:
• **Ads (58 live):** 14 get a Halloween version, 34 need a refresh first (pre-#1452 captures or music baked into the master), 2 reuse Marcus's existing cheer fastcouch Halloween cuts, and 8 are skipped because they only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12. Every ART ticket has its call and due date in a comment. The 48 that need work are assigned to Marcus (videos and end cards) or Martin (Julia's statics). Refreshes are due Wed Oct 8, and every Halloween ad goes to Frederick by Wed Oct 15 for the Oct 18-31 flight.
• **Two ads missing from the live sheet:** julia 4:5 (ART-826, our best iOS UK CPI) and Marcus's portrait end card (ART-831). Both are in the plan.
• **Store:** the iPhone and Google Play Halloween sets are already exported (reuse). New tickets: <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855|ART-855> for the iPad 12.9" set and <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-856|ART-856> for a simpler icon, both Martin, due Oct 15.
• **Icon timing:** we can't swap it on the 24th by itself, because on iOS the icon ships in the build. Its only window is the Oct 17 submission (merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT), live around Oct 22. Proposal: upload the Google Play icon Oct 21 so both stores switch on Oct 22, and revert with the Nov 6 submission.

precheck.final_response:
The plan doc and tracker are in your Drive, shared with all six people on Thursday's review (Leonard, Frederick, Martin, Marcus, Robert, Arthur) with comment access, and both links are posted in Leonard's thread.

- **Plan:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/37dbe022571a2be12f93ffe1/edit
- **Tracker** (tabs for store, ads and key dates): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit
- **Slack reply:** https://harmonygamesgroup.slack.com/archives/C06DJBJL798/p1759302639000000?thread_ts=1759269913.882683&cid=C06DJBJL798

**How the calls were made**
- **Robert's deck:** anything captured before the Jul 29 zombie swap (Android #1452), or with music baked into the video, gets refreshed first. Anything that already has a Halloween version gets reused.
- **Frederick's Sep 30 email:** the Android US tablet campaign ends Oct 12, so ads that only run there are skipped. The Halloween flight is Oct 18–31, and every Halloween ad has to reach him by Wed Oct 15.
- **Arthur's calendar:** the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. Its merge cut is Thu Oct 16 at 12:00 PT, and it should be live around Oct 22 after Apple review.

**Ads: 58 live, not 56.** Two ads that are running are missing from the live creatives sheet: Julia's 4:5 static (ART-826, still the best iOS UK CPI per Frederick) and Marcus's portrait end card (ART-831). I've included both.

doc.body:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan (store + ads)
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art Lead). For the Halloween review, Thu Oct 2. Comments welcome on anything below.
Tracker (every ad and store surface, with call, maker and due date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_eQJMHAXysaELXTzzSrDGl9eQvNJi2_DiTljD2jzH00/edit

1. Goal
Leonard's brief (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30): everything players see from ZM3D looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October. That means the store pages and every ad we're running. Art owns working out what gets a Halloween version, what needs work first, what we already have, and who makes what by when.

2. Inputs used
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick): 4 store surfaces and 56 Unity creatives live today, plus capture and master notes on each ART ticket.
- Halloween push card on the ZM roadmap: Frederick says Julia's 4:5 static ("They're coming, stop them!", ART-826) is still live on iOS UK and is our best CPI there, but it's missing from the sheet. It's counted in, so there are 57 ads in scope.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12 draft and Sep 30 changes):
  - The Halloween flight is now Sat Oct 18 – Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone.
  - The Android US tablet campaign ends Sun Oct 12, so nothing that only runs there gets a Halloween version.
  - Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15, not Oct 17, so Unity can approve it before the flight.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar:
  - The Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. The merge cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT.
  - iOS screenshots only change with a new version.
  - Apple review takes up to 3 days, so plan on the iOS build and listing being live from Wed Oct 22.
  - Google Play listing graphics can go up any day, with 1 day of review.
  - The Nov 6 submission puts the icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025 deck:
  - Seasonal dressing only goes on top of the current art.
  - Anything captured or rendered before Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap) gets redone on the current build first, unless a later capture has replaced it.
  - A master with music baked in gets re-cut from a music-free master first.
  - Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment). Same background, pose, zombie order and CTA.
  - The four calls are Halloween version, Refresh first, Reuse and Skip.
- What already exists:
  - Martin's Halloween store screens, exported Sep 30 to ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store: iPhone 6.5" x5 and Google Play phone x6.
  - Marcus's cheer fastcouch Halloween cuts in 9:16 and 16:9 (ZM3D Halloween 2025 / UA masters).
  - Robert's note on Martin's Sep 17 Halloween icon concept: too busy for the app icon, keep it as simple as the current one.
  - Leonard in #zombie-art: anything already exported is done, and tickets are only for store art that still has to be made.
- Owners: Martin makes the icon and stills (store screens and statics). Marcus makes video and end cards.

3. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play), Halloween version, new art.
  - Martin makes it, on new ticket ART-855.
  - Art goes to Arthur by Tue Oct 14 so it's merged before the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut.
  - Leonard floated swapping around the 24th, but that isn't possible: the icon ships in the build, and the Oct 17 build is the last one before Halloween. The icon goes live with that build, which is expected on iOS from about Wed Oct 22, and reverts with the Nov 6 submission.
  - Per Robert, it stays as simple as the current icon, with only the seasonal layer.
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse.
  - Martin's Sep 30 export is done.
  - It must be attached to the Oct 17 submission by the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut. Live from about Oct 22, back to normal Nov 6.
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version, new art.
  - No Halloween iPad set exists yet.
  - Martin makes it, on new ticket ART-856, due Wed Oct 15 so it's ready for the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut. Live from about Oct 22, back to normal Nov 6.
- Google Play phone set: Reuse.
  - Martin's Sep 30 export is done.
  - Upload Thu Oct 16 so it's live by Fri Oct 17 / Sat Oct 18, in step with the UA flight.
  - Proposal: revert to the normal set Fri Oct 31.

4. Ads (57 Unity creatives)
- Halloween version: 12 ads.
  - All 12 are Marcus's: 4 marcus.bennett cuts (9:16, 16:9, 4:5, 1:1), 4 end card 001 versions (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5), cheer fastcouch 4:5, barrel marketing2 1:1, couch alpha 50 4:5 and balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9.
  - They were captured or rendered on the current art with music-free masters.
  - marcus.bennett 9:16 has music baked in, but Marcus exported no-music SFX versions on Aug 13, so it's cut from those.
  - Due to Frederick Wed Oct 15.
- Refresh first: 35 ads (Marcus 29, Martin 6).
  - The source predates the Jul 29 zombie swap. That covers April–July captures, Dec 2024 prototype captures, the Jun 5 #852 stills behind Julia's statics, and the end card template rendered from #456.
  - 6 of them (ART-796, 798, 799, 802, 807 and 847) also have music baked in and need a music-free re-cut.
  - boris fastcouch 9:16 counts too. Its Boris opening was added Sep 11, but the gameplay is still the Jul 28 capture (Android #1427).
  - Refreshed base done by Wed Oct 8, Halloween pass to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
  - Martin owns the 6 Julia statics, including ART-826.
- Reuse: 2 ads.
  - cheer fastcouch 9:16 (ART-808) and 16:9 (ART-816). Marcus has already made the Halloween cuts from the Sep 16 #1896 re-capture.
  - Frederick can queue them now.
- Skip: 8 ads.
  - These only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12: ART-806, 820, 821, 822, 824, 842, 844 and 849.
- Every ad's ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date.
- The 47 that need new work are assigned to their maker (Marcus 41, Martin 6) with a due date of Wed Oct 15, so Frederick can queue uploads as they land.

5. Who makes what, by when
Marcus — video and end cards:
- 12 Halloween versions, due Oct 15.
- 29 refresh-first ads: base by Oct 8, Halloween by Oct 15.
Martin — icon and stills:
- Icon (ART-855), due Oct 14.
- iPad set (ART-856), due Oct 15.
- 6 Julia statics: refresh by Oct 8, Halloween by Oct 15.
Frederick:
- Queue the 2 reused cheer fastcouch cuts now.
- Upload the rest to Unity as they land, all by Oct 15, for the Oct 18 flight.
Arthur:
- Merge the icon, and attach the iPhone and iPad sets to the Oct 17 submission (cut Oct 16 12:00 PT).
- Revert both with the Nov 6 submission.
Store listing (Leonard / whoever owns the GP console):
- Upload the Google Play Halloween set Oct 16.
- Revert Oct 31.

6. Risks and open questions for the review
- Load: Marcus has 41 ads in two weeks, 29 of them needing a re-capture first. If that doesn't fit, I'd keep the iOS UK phone/tablet and Android US phone formats with the most spend and Skip the rest. Frederick, can you flag the low-spend refresh-first ads we could drop?
- Icon timing: the icon can't swap around Oct 24. It goes live with the Oct 17 build (iOS about Oct 22). Leonard, OK?
- Google Play revert date: Oct 31 or Nov 1? GP isn't tied to the Nov 6 build.
- Re-captures need a current build (Android #1966 or later) and a capture slot from QA/Julia this week.
- The live creatives sheet is missing ART-826 (Julia 4:5). Frederick, worth adding it back.

new_tickets.title: ZM3D Halloween app icon (App Store + Google Play)
new_tickets.description:
Halloween push for Zombie Match 3D (store + ads, roadmap card "Halloween push").

**What:** a Halloween version of the live app icon (live since Sep 17), for App Store and Google Play.

**Direction (Robert):** keep it as simple as the current icon. The Sep 17 Halloween icon concept was too busy at icon size, so this is a new pass. Only the seasonal layer changes, per the Q4 seasonal art direction deck (e.g. pumpkin or fog accent, title treatment), with the same zombie, pose and flat background.

**Timing (Arthur's Q4 release calendar):** the icon ships in the build, so it has to ride the Oct 17 submission. The merge cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT.
- Art final to Arthur by **Tue Oct 14** so it can be merged before the cut.
- Expected live with the build from about Wed Oct 22 (Apple review takes up to 3 days).
- It can't be swapped on Oct 24 on its own, because there's no build then.
- It goes back to the normal icon with the Nov 6 submission.

Owner: Martin. Plan + tracker linked in #zombie_marketing.

slack_posts.text:
Halloween plan + tracker are ready for Thursday's review :jack_o_lantern: Everyone on the invite can comment on both.
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/02b4668f970d6142eb316a91/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_eQJMHAXysaELXTzzSrDGl9eQvNJi2_DiTljD2jzH00/edit

*Ads (57: the 56 on the live sheet plus Julia's 4:5, ART-826, per Frederick's roadmap note)*
• 12 Halloween version: current-art captures with clean masters.
• 35 refresh first: pre-Jul 29 captures or music-baked masters. Base by Oct 8, then the Halloween pass.
• 2 reuse: cheer fastcouch 9:16 and 16:9 are already done, so Frederick can queue them now.
• 8 skip: Android US tablet only, which ends Oct 12.
• Every ART ticket has its call and due date in a comment. The 47 that need work are assigned (Marcus 41, Martin 6), and all are due to Frederick Wed Oct 15 for the Oct 18 flight.

*Store*
• iPhone 6.5" and GP phone sets: reuse Martin's Sep 30 exports.
• New tickets for Martin:
  • Halloween icon <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855|ART-855>, due Oct 14
  • iPad 12.9" set <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-856|ART-856>, due Oct 15
• Leonard, on the icon: it can't swap on the 24th by itself. It ships in the build, so it rides the Oct 17 submission (Oct 16 12:00 PT cut) and goes live about Oct 22 on iOS with the iOS screenshots. Everything reverts with the Nov 6 build.
• GP screens can go up Oct 16 so they're live for the flight.

Open questions for Thursday are in section 6 of the plan, mainly Marcus's load and the GP revert date.

precheck-rev3.final_response:
Everything's done for Thursday's review. The plan doc and tracker are in your Drive, and the six other people on the review can comment on both. All 57 ART tickets are commented and assigned where needed, two new store tickets are open, and I've replied in Leonard's thread with the links.

- **Plan doc:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/02b4668f970d6142eb316a91/edit
- **Tracker:** https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_eQJMHAXysaELXTzzSrDGl9eQvNJi2_DiTljD2jzH00/edit
- **Slack reply:** https://harmonygamesgroup.slack.com/archives/C06DJBJL798/p1759302594000000?thread_ts=1759269913.882683&cid=C06DJBJL798

**What changed from Leonard's brief**
- **New deadline:** Frederick's update yesterday moved the flight to Oct 18–31, so every Halloween ad is now due to him Wed Oct 15, not Oct 17.
- **Android US tablet ends Oct 12,** so ads that only run there get no Halloween version.
- **Icon swap on the 24th isn't possible.** The icon ships inside the app build, so it has to go in the Oct 17 build (art due Oct 14) and goes live around Oct 22, at the same time as the new iPhone and iPad screenshots. Leonard needs to OK this.
- **One extra ad:** Frederick says Julia's 4:5 static (ART-826) is still live and is the best performer on iOS UK, but it's missing from the live creatives sheet. I included it, so there are 57 ads, not 56.

**Ad calls (57)**

| Call | Count | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Halloween version | 12 | Captured after the Jul 29 zombie swap, with music-free masters. All Marcus's. |
| Refresh first | 35 | Captured before the swap, and 6 also have music baked into the master. Refreshed version by Oct 8, Halloween by Oct 15. Marcus 29, Martin 6 (the Julia statics). |
| Reuse | 2 | Cheer fastcouch 9:16 and 16:9. Marcus already made these, so Frederick can queue them now. |
| Skip | 8 | Only run on Android US tablet. |

Each ticket's comment gives the call, the reason and the due date. The 47 that need work are assigned to Marcus or Martin with an Oct 15 due date. I left their status as Done, so they won't appear in anyone's open queue unless you reopen them.

**Store**
- **iPhone 6.5" and Google Play phone screenshots:** Martin already exported Halloween versions on Sep 30, so no new tickets were needed.
- **App icon (ART-855, Martin, due Oct 14):** needs new art, because Robert said Martin's Sep 17 concept was too busy at icon size.
- **iPad 12.9" screenshots (ART-856, Martin, due Oct 15):** no Halloween version exists yet.
- **Timing:** Google Play screenshots can go up Oct 16 so they're live for the flight. The icon and iOS screenshots go back to normal with the Nov 6 build.

**Open questions for the review**
- **Marcus's load:** he has 41 ads in two weeks, 29 of which need a new capture first. If that doesn't fit, Frederick could flag low-spend ads to drop.
- **Google Play revert:** I proposed Oct 31; it could also be Nov 1.
